What I look at

  • Your profile and bio: do they turn visitors into followers?
  • Your content and hooks: what’s working and what isn’t
  • Reach signals: watch time, shares, and saves
  • Your niche and keywords: can the platform tell who to show you to?
  • Your posting rhythm: can you keep it up?
  • A prioritized list of what to fix first
